title: Voyager 1 is one light-day from Earth

lines.text: A spacecraft from 1977 just did something no machine ever has.
lines.say: A spacecraft from nineteen seventy-seven just did something no machine ever has.

lines.text: Voyager 1 is now one full light-day from Earth!
lines.say: Voyager One is now one full light-day from Earth!

lines.text: Wait. What even is a light-day?
lines.say: Wait. What even is a light-day?

lines.text: Step one. It's how far light travels in 24 hours.
lines.say: Step one. It's how far light travels in twenty-four hours.
That's about twenty-five point nine billion kilometers.

lines.text: So a message takes a whole day to reach it?
lines.say: So a message takes a whole day to reach it?

lines.text: Step two. Yep, 24 hours, one way.
lines.say: Step two. Yep, twenty-four hours, one way.

lines.text: Ask it a question, wait two days for the answer.
lines.say: Ask it a question, wait two days for the answer.

lines.text: And it took 49 years to get that far?
lines.say: And it took forty-nine years to get that far?

lines.text: Step three. It flies about 61,000 kilometers an hour.
lines.say: Step three. It flies about sixty-one thousand kilometers an hour.

lines.text: One light-year would take it 17,600 years.
lines.say: One light-year would take it seventeen thousand six hundred years.

lines.text: Okay, that's wild. Is it still working?
lines.say: Okay, that's wild. Is it still working?

lines.text: Still phoning home, from interstellar space.
lines.say: Still phoning home, from interstellar space.

lines.text: It still carries a golden record of sounds from Earth.
lines.say: It still carries a golden record of sounds from Earth.

lines.text: And Voyager 2 hits the same mark in 2035.
lines.say: And Voyager Two hits the same mark in twenty thirty-five.

lines.text: Subscribe to my channel for more videos like this!
lines.say: Subscribe to my channel for more videos like this!
